main_text.head: 20. De Reformationibus Temporum.
main_text.p: NUlla adeô invidenda est Gloria, quâm quæ ex debita Ecclesiæ vel Status Reformatione acquiritur, nisi cùm sint deformitates ejusmodi, ut ipsa Motum incidentium, & Novitatum incommoda bonum Reformationis exsuperent.
Hunc licet mihi Deus honorem negaret, ut Instrumentum fiam tam præclari Operis, quoquo modo tamen effectum lætarer.

Grata sanè in initio Parlamenti hujus studia fuere, ut quicquid Temporum Indulgentia, vel corruptela morum pravi induxerat reformaretur: jam non minùs discrucior, cùm his Turbis Factionum libertatemParlamenti oppressam videam, cumque Legum extantium, & Religionis sancitæ (quæ Mensura & Canon Reformationis esse debuerant (nullam prorsùs rationem haberi, & eâ porrò iniqui-tate,

page.notes: Line 1 of the paragraph's last sentence runs on past the page; the paragraph continues. Possible printing faults: "libertatemParlamenti" lacks a space as printed; "hujus" is printed with a long-s-like glyph (read as hujus); "(nullam" and "debuerant (" parentheses are as printed. The ornament "•" after "perent." and the mark after "Temporum." are printer's marks, not text.
